title: Shakti Polytarp IPO Details
intro:
Shakti Polytarp IPO is a book build issue of ₹26.93 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 45.64 lakh shares of ₹26.93 crore.

Shakti Polytarp IPO opens for subscription on Sep 15, 2026 and closes on Sep 17, 2026. The allotment for the Shakti Polytarp IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 18, 2026. Shakti Polytarp IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Sep 22, 2026.

Shakti Polytarp IPO is set issue price band at ₹56 to ₹59 per share. The lot size for an application is 2,000 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,36,000 (4,000 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (6,000 shares), amounting to ₹3,54,000.

NEXGEN Financial Solutions Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Skyline Financial Services Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to Shakti Polytarp IPO DRHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in March 2018, Shakti Polytarp Limited manufactures tarpaulin and Shade Net. Its products are manufactured from PP Granules, Linear Low-Density Polyethylene (LLDPE), Low-Density Polyethylene (LDPE) and High-Density Polyethylene (HDPE), which are used across industries including agriculture, construction, automotive, transportation, logistics, and consumer goods.
The company offers comprehensive services, helping clients choose the appropriate tarpaulin and providing design and customization options for their applications.

The company operates on a B2B (Business-to-Business) model, supplying tarpaulin and other products to various industries and in the B2C (Business-to-Consumer) segment, offering its products directly to consumers.
Its manufacturing unit spans 18,432 sq. meters and is located in Khargone, Madhya Pradesh.
As of January 31, 2025, the company had a total of 76 employees on its payroll.

faqs.question: How to apply in Shakti Polytarp IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Shakti Polytarp IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Shakti Polytarp IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Shakti Polytarp IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Shakti Polytarp IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.answer: Shakti Polytarp IPO lot size is 2000 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹2,36,000 , with 2 lots being the minimum application size .

faqs.question: How to apply for Shakti Polytarp IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Shakti Polytarp IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Shakti Polytarp IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Shakti Polytarp IPO will be done on Friday, September 18, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Mon, Sep 21, 2026 . Check the Shakti Polytarp IPO allotment status .

faqs.question: When is Shakti Polytarp IPO listing date ?
faqs.answer: The Shakti Polytarp IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Tue, Sep 22, 2026 .
